The extension preserves the native topic contract.

No catalogue class reads nav_msgs/Odometry pose and twist for a world.sim resource. cap.sensing.read.v1 binds sensor, sensor.imu and sensor.force_torque resources, not the WPR plugin's odometry topic.
No catalogue class reads a geometry_msgs/Pose2D pose difference for a world.sim resource. cap.sensing.read.v1 does not bind world.sim and this message is not an IMU or force/torque sample.

No catalogue class re-enables a simulated world after a safety reset: this declared re-enable (CORE-086) unpauses the Gazebo world through gazebo_ros /gazebo/unpause_physics (std_srvs/Empty), a reviewed companion source of the card; the latch refuses it and the reset never runs it.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Confirmed the author's block: the pinned ROS 1 WPRPlugin only subscribes cmd_vel and publishes odom, wpb_home_sim only publishes and subscribes topics, and no file offers a stop, pause or reset service, so the stock e-stop fails G6.ESTOP_FAILED and G8 SAFE-028 with the latch held (HELPER_MISSING); every endpoint, the ROS 1 types, the nested Odometry read schemas, the operator_required Twist bounds and the R2 risk were checked against the pin. Defects: a fact claimed the plugin 'retains no target', while UpdateChild keeps driving toward the stored x_, y_ and rot_ at every world update with no timeout (wpr_plugin.cpp:186-207, 237-243); /wpb_home/pose_diff was part of the device resource although its only publisher, wpb_home_sim, is started only by wpb_home_controllers.launch and not by the cited wpb_simple.launch, and a reviewer probe with it silent showed every resource read failing NOT_READY and each command waiting 2 s; and the pose_diff fact omitted the upstream 0.9 scaling of x and y, another fact added an absence claim, and the update fact's range missed the odometry publish. The reviewer removed pose_diff from the resource (it stays an explicit read capability), corrected four facts and added two, extended safe_state, and added three fidelity gaps (driver.py); added a case that the resource read does not wait for pose_diff (test_driver.py); updated facts.md; and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate still fails only G6 and G8 (stable digest sha256:9f2611469db75de88a763d3e2f1bc0e914d33edf8197e2e51fe8e6907efb5db4, unchanged from the author's run), the eight package cases pass, and collect.py --strict shows no warning; RESULT.json was left as the author wrote it. For the human reviewer: Simulation only (ROS 1 Gazebo, WPB Home). WPRPlugin holds the last cmd_vel forever: one publication keeps the simulated base moving until another arrives, and a zero Twist is an unacknowledged publication. pose_diff exists only in the manipulation scenarios (wpb_home_mani, wpb_scene_1, wpb_table); its x and y are scaled by 0.9 and are relative to the last 'pose_diff reset' ctrl message. Unblocking needs an acknowledged stop the clone names (for example a Gazebo pause service), or an SDK profile for one.
